name: com.gamecore.gameplay.dialogue
description: Catalog row 6 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.4): dialogue and narrative. Authoring: FactDefinition (name, initial value, persistence) and DialogueGraphDefinition (line, choice, branch, action and end nodes joined by edges). Kernel half: the narrative state target with the dialogue.active/graph/node/speaker/listener/choiceCount slots and one narrative.fact.<name> slot per baked fact, visited bits per graph, the dialogue.start/choose/advance/interrupt and narrative.setFact routes and the Started/LineShown/ChoiceOffered/ChoiceMade/DialogueEnded/FactSet/ActionNode events. Runtime: DialogueRunner (IConversationStarter), DialoguePresenter (IDialogueView) and VoiceLinePlayer (IVoiceLinePlayer). Editor: dialogue.addLine, addChoice, linkCondition, setFact, preview and generateVoice.
